name: @gjsify/system-accounts
description: The accounts a user already set up on their system: find them, read their mail server settings, get credentials. GNOME Online Accounts on Linux.

scripts.clear: gjsify clear lib tmp tsconfig.tsbuildinfo test.gjs.mjs test.node.mjs
scripts.build: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:types
scripts.build:test: gjsify run build:test:gjs && gjsify run build:test:node
scripts.test: gjsify run build:gjsify && gjsify run build:test && gjsify run test:node && gjsify run test:gjs
scripts.test:gjs: gjsify env DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/nonexistent XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/nonexistent gjsify run test.gjs.mjs

osNotes.darwin: No driver: the package answers with empty capabilities (ADR 0095). macOS has no system-account API for third-party apps that was found; this is not proven either way.
osNotes.win32: No driver: the package answers with empty capabilities (ADR 0095). No system-account API for third-party apps was found; this is not proven either way.
